name: reverse-translate and assemble multi-domain protein-coding DNA with inter-domain linkers in fixed order
definition: Reverse-translate required protein domains in a fixed N-to-C order and place glycine-serine linkers only between adjacent domains to produce a faithful coding sequence.
failure_mode: Insertion/deletion or ordering error breaks the translated sequence.

name: set up a automatic speech recognition model or toolchain that runs on CPU
definition: Install/configure a text-to-speech-recognition tool or open-source model that can transcribe audio without a GPU.
failure_mode: Setup fails or tool requires unavailable hardware, so no transcript is produced.
